title.zh: 复盘：除数变号后仍用恒等式核对
title.en: Review a changed divisor with the same integer identity

paragraphs.zh: 新例print(17 // -5, 17 % -5, sep=":")输出-4:-3。商17/(-5)为-3.4，向下取整是-4；余数由17=(-4)*(-5)+(-3)核得-3，与负除数同号。对照print(-17 // 5, -17 % 5, sep=":")的-4:3，商虽然相同，余数符号不同。先分别代回整数恒等式，不把其他语言的向零截断规则或“余数总为正”带进来。两段都用CPython 3.14.5核过，是不计分新例。
paragraphs.en: In a fresh example, print(17 // -5, 17 % -5, sep=":") prints -4:-3. The quotient before flooring is -3.4, so its floor is -4. Check the remainder using 17=(-4)*(-5)+(-3); it has the negative divisor’s sign. Compare print(-17 // 5, -17 % 5, sep=":"), which prints -4:3. Equal floor quotients do not require equal remainders. Substitute each pair into the integer identity rather than importing truncation toward zero or assuming every remainder is positive. Both unscored examples were checked with CPython 3.14.5.

title.zh: 复盘：负步长也不包含停止边界
title.en: Review the excluded stop with a negative step

paragraphs.zh: 新例values=range(9, 2, -3)，print(",".join(str(n) for n in values), sum(values), sep=":")输出9,6,3:18。步长为-3，依次取9、6、3；下一项0越过边界，不加入。仅把停止值2改成3，3也被排除，输出9,6:15。先列实际项，再求和，别把终点当必取项。range可再次迭代，本例不是一次性迭代器；不要把第一次join误当成已耗尽后续sum的输入。两个独立脚本均已用CPython 3.14.5核过，不计分。
paragraphs.en: Let values=range(9, 2, -3), then use print(",".join(str(n) for n in values), sum(values), sep=":"). Output is 9,6,3:18. Stepping by negative three visits nine, six and three; zero would cross the stopping boundary. Changing only the stop from two to three excludes three too, giving 9,6:15. List actual terms before summing. The range object can be iterated again: it is not a one-shot iterator, so join does not exhaust the later sum input here. Both independent scripts were checked with CPython 3.14.5 as unscored revision.

title.zh: 复盘：后备值与新条目分两步记录
title.en: Review fallback lookup separately from insertion

paragraphs.zh: 新例counts={"elm":2}，依次执行first=counts.get("oak",7)、before=len(counts)、counts["oak"]=first，再print(first,before,len(counts),sep=":")，输出7:1:2。get返回7时没有插入oak，所以before为1；之后明确赋值才新增条目，长度变2。把返回值与字典状态分列，不因已拿到后备值就认为它已存入。若oak本已存在，get会给原值，后续同键赋值也不会新增相等键。该独立脚本已在CPython 3.14.5核对，不计分。
paragraphs.en: Start counts={"elm":2}, then execute first=counts.get("oak",7), before=len(counts), counts["oak"]=first and print(first,before,len(counts),sep=":"). Output is 7:1:2. The get call returns seven without inserting oak, leaving before at one. Only the explicit assignment adds an entry and changes length to two. Track returned value and dictionary state separately. If oak already existed, get would return its stored value and assigning that equal key would not add another entry. This independent script was checked with CPython 3.14.5 and is unscored.

title.zh: 复盘：成功进入后，退出是否压制异常
title.en: Review whether a successful entry leads to suppression on exit

paragraphs.zh: 新事件例的__enter__记录enter并成功返回；with主体先记录body，再raise ValueError("demo")；__exit__记录exit并返回False；外层except ValueError记录handled。按冒号连接得enter:body:exit:handled，主体之后、仍在try里的after记录不会运行。仅将__exit__返回值改True，异常被压制，轨迹变enter:body:exit:after，外层except不运行。这两个独立CPython 3.14.5脚本已核对，只改虚构事件列表、不获取资源，也不把这一成功进入条件推广到进入失败。
paragraphs.en: In a fresh event trace, __enter__ records enter and returns successfully. The with body records body and raises ValueError("demo"). __exit__ records exit and returns False; an outer except ValueError records handled. Joining events with colons gives enter:body:exit:handled. An after event placed after with, still inside try, is skipped. Changing only the exit return to True suppresses the exception, producing enter:body:exit:after without the outer handler. Both independent CPython 3.14.5 scripts were checked. They change only a fictional event list, acquire no resources and do not extend the successful-entry condition to failed entry.
